utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — can you remind me which spot we’re using for the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We’re using the community center for the drop-off, and the main thing to keep lined up is Sunday. Do you want me to check what’s already confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’m still tracking what supplies are missing for the repair drive, and I’ll wait on the schedule until the hall drop-off time is set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — once the hall drop-off time is set, I can line up the repair drive timing from there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on — what part do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, just please keep my part low-key for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep it low-key and pass along the community hall meetup first, then we’ll sort the repair drive timing there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can keep track of the supplies—what do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great — I’ll list the remaining jobs and what supplies we still need, then we can go over it Saturday at 10 at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — I can check what we still need for the repair drive and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m a bit behind, but I can help with setup or carrying stuff. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — Sunday at the community center works, and setup help would be great. I’ll keep it low-key and share any details you need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center. I’m just lining up the drop-off time now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s meet at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s use the community center entrance—easy to unload there. I’ll send the exact time and a quick list of jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—send the time and job list, and I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s pin down the community hall drop-off time first, and then I can sort out the repair drive timing. What works for you, Opal?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping track of the repair drive locations—want the drop-off spot first, or the next place on the list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can swing by with the tools for the repair drive, and if you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Gus — I’ll start spreading the word, and if you can bring the tools, we’re in good shape. Just tell me the drop-off time once it’s set.
